notes.title: Gatewalkers - Frequently Asked Questions
notes.content:
Gatewalkers - UPDATED Frequently Asked Questions

Greetings Gatewalkers! Here is the updated version of the answers to the most common questions. If you don't find the answer you're looking for here, go ahead and ask us whatever you want in the comments section.

What type of game is Gatewalkers?
Gatewalkers is a cooperative action RPG and survival game, where players travel across different worlds in order to save their own. Explore procedurally generated worlds, face hostile inhabitants, face challenges like extreme weather conditions, toxic atmosphere, lack of water, and more.

When the game is going to be released?
We are planning to release Gatewalkers on Q2/Q3 2021. The exact date of releasing the full version has not yet been established.

Do you already know the price of the game on the day of its release?
It's a bit too early for that.

Will there be a single-player mode?
Although the game is meant to be played in multiplayer, there will be a single-player mode available too. What is important to add, that the entire story can be played in both modes: solo and in cooperation.

How about local multiplayer mode?
Currently, we are not working on local multiplayer mode. We are now focused on solo and online coop experience.

How many players can play together at once?
In cooperation, you are able to play up to 4 players.

What are the system requirements for the game?
It is still too early to tell you for sure, but we plan to optimize the game to allow players to enjoy the gameplay on most PCs (not just high-spec ones).

Are you planning to support XBOX/PS controllers?
Yes, we are. Currently, we are working on adding the XBOX controller and PS4 controller.

Are you working on a Linux version?
No. The game will be officially released on PC and Mac. However, we do not exclude support for gamers who want to run the game on Linux.

Are you planning to release Gatewalkers on consoles?
Yes, we are! We are planning to support XBOX and PS consoles, but the porting will be done after the PC version release. The exact dates of the console release are still unknown.

 Are there predefined levels in the game?
No, we are procedurally generating the map at the start of each expedition.

Are you planning open/closed beta tests?
Yes, we have done some tests and we are planning to make more of them till release.

How can I sign for the alpha/beta tests?
The best way to join alpha/beta tests is to add Gatewalkers to your wishlist. Then you should see all information about upcoming tests and how to join them inside the Steam client.

Where is the right place to report the bug I have encounter during tests?
The best place to do so is on our Discord server: https://discordapp.com/invite/8Tn76pT

Where can I follow the game development?
The best place to follow the game development is at our social media:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/GatewalkersGame/
Twitter: @GatewalkersGame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gatewalkersgame/
Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/8Tn76pT

Is the game going to have achievements and Steam cards?
Yes. Both achievements and Steam cards are going to be implemented.

Are you looking for talents?
We are always open to talented people so if you feel that you would be a good candidate for our team send as info to contact@a2softworks.com.

notes.title: Alpha Patch #3 + GIFT
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers,

Gatewalkers alpha tests have been going on for some time now and we will be slowly finishing them (we'll give you the exact date later). To appreciate the fact that you are with us, we have prepared a small gift for you! It is an exclusive item, only for alpha players, A GUILD MEMBER CAPE. Take a look!

Everyone who logs in to the game should find a guild cape in their inventory and receive a recipe for its creation.

With this update, we have also make some minor changes and fixes:
- minor FX glitches
- minor graphic problems
- navigation issues in few places
- small technical issues

Best of luck Gatewalkers!
Gatewalkers Dev Team

notes.title: Alpha Patch #2
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers,

We have uploaded a second patch for the alpha version of the game. Most important fixes are pointed below:


 fix of an issue that allows you to duplicate items in your inventory
 fix of the problem where some of the players can not load expedition (endless loading)
 fix the problem where some of the players encountered DC after clicking the "PLAY" button
 fix of minor fixes of graphical glitches and minor stability issues


We hope you are still enjoying playing Gatewalkers! 
The alpha is slowly coming to an end. The exact alpha end date will be announced soon.

Gatewalkers Dev Team

notes.title: Alpha Patch #1
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers,

We have uploaded a first big fix for the current alpha version of the game. Below you have more detail about them:


 fix of nickname issue, where players could not play because of their player's name on steam had illegal characters or is too short / too long. Now players can change the character name at the login screen.
 fix of problem where players had no starting equipment and empty storage chest
 fix of some login server issues
 fix of Surian Guardian Secret Chest. Now Surian forest secret box guardians are spawning correctly and this box drops appropriate reward
 fix of lack of gem to craft Stamina Ring. Now players can find Peridot gem in challenge boxes and secret boxes.
 fix of minor fixes of graphical glitches and minor stability issues


We hope you are still enjoying playing Gatewalkers, and all players that were unable to play now will try the game!

Gatewalkers Dev Team
